2607.28080.title: On a joint simultaneous learning of relevant feature subsets and subspaces in regression-like problems
2607.28080.paper_summary: We extend a recently introduced Entropy-Optimal Manifold Clustering (EOMC) to allow for a joint simultaneous identification of subsets and subspaces of relevant features in nonstationary and nonlinear regression problems. It is shown that the proposed extension - that we coin as Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression (EOMR) - allows a robust learning with linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities. EOMR is compared to the most complete set of state-of-the-art tools from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) that is available to the author, on the very challenging problems from chaotic and fluid dynamics: (i) on predicting the Lorenz-96 systems dynamics in strongly- and very-strongly chaotic regimes (with forcing parameter being $F=8$ and $F=12$, respectively); and, (ii) on a data from the Hasegawa-Wakatani model on the edge of the tokamak plasma. It is demonstrated that the proposed benchmarks (i) and (ii), indeed, are the very challenging problems for the state of the art ML and AI tools - since both the general-purpose gradient boosted random forests and deep neuronal networks, as well as transformer-based AI tools like TabPFN v.03 (more spezialised for large-dimensional small data learning problems) - result in orders of magnitude inferior root mean squared prediction errors, and orders of magnitude larger model complexities, when compared to the EOMR. For a Hasegawa-Wakatani example, EOMR distills a very simple entropy-optimal and skilful description of the leading Essential Orthogonal Function (EOF) dynamics, given by linear, causal and weakly-stationary autoregressive process described by just 8 parameters.
2607.28080.paper_summary_zh: 我們擴展了一種最近提出的熵最優流形聚類（EOMC），以便在非平穩和非線性回歸問題中實現相關特徵的子集和子空間的聯合同時識別。研究表明，所提出的擴展——我們稱之為熵最優流形回歸（EOMR）——允許以線性擴展的迭代和記憶複雜度進行穩健學習。EOMR 與作者所能獲得的最完整的人工智慧（AI）和機器學習（ML）最先進工具集進行比較，針對來自混沌和流體動力學的非常具有挑戰性的問題：（i）在強混沌和非常強混沌範圍內預測洛倫茲-96系統的動態（強迫參數分別為 $F=8$ 和 $F=12$）；以及，（ii）在接近托卡馬克等離子體的 Hasegawa-Wakatani 模型數據上。證明了所提出的基準（i）和（ii）確實是最先進的 ML 和 AI 工具所面臨的非常具有挑戰性的問題——因為通用的梯度提升隨機森林和深度神經網絡，以及基於Transformer的 AI 工具如 TabPFN v.03（更專門針對大維度小數據學習問題）——在與 EOMR 相比時，導致的均方根預測誤差低幾個數量級，且模型複雜度高幾個數量級。對於 Hasegawa-Wakatani 的例子，EOMR 提煉出一個非常簡單的熵最優和巧妙的主導本質正交函數（EOF）動態描述，該描述由僅用 8 個參數描述的線性、因果和弱平穩自回歸過程給出。
